audience: teams that run weekly progress reports, objectives and KPIs in Weekdone

useCases.title: Read the weekly report for each team
useCases.text: Get the weekly report grouped by team, with each user's items and ratings. Ask the assistant which items need attention.

useCases.title: Review objectives and KPIs
useCases.text: List the objectives with their progress and key results. List the KPIs with their current values.

useCases.title: Find the items of one user or team
useCases.text: Search the report items of one week by user or team. Read the comments on an item before you reply to it.

useCases.title: Add plan items to a weekly report
useCases.text: Look up the item types, then create a plan item in the week you choose. Assign the item to a teammate when needed.

useCases.title: Update the value of a KPI
useCases.text: List the KPIs with their current values. Then set a new value for one KPI.

useCases.title: Reply to a report item and update it
useCases.text: Read the comments on a report item, then add your reply. Update the text, priority or due date of the item when the plan changes.
